description: Every Woolworths catalogue, specials, store and trolley surface, plus a local price history that can tell a genuine half-price from an inflated was-price.

novel_features.name: Genuine-special verdict
novel_features.description: Tells you whether an advertised special is genuinely cheap or just a lower number next to an inflated was-price.

novel_features.name: Half-price cycle forecast
novel_features.description: Estimates when a product's next half-price window is likely to open, from its own recorded discount episodes.

novel_features.name: Cheaper substitute finder
novel_features.description: Ranks in-stock alternatives by unit price normalised across different measure bases, so per-100g and per-1kg tiles compare correctly.

novel_features.name: Basket costing from a list
novel_features.description: Prices a whole shopping list, showing which lines moved since the last time you ran it and what it did to the total.

novel_features.name: Specials rollover diff
novel_features.description: Shows what entered and left each specials group since your last sync, with how long since each entrant was last discounted.

novel_features.name: Multi-buy effective unit price
novel_features.description: Works out what a multi-buy offer actually costs per unit at the quantity it demands, versus buying singly or buying a larger pack.
